# Runtime Architecture

This page references [the stable API](./reference.md#stable-api), a
[missing local anchor](./reference.md#missing-anchor), and a moved source path
`../src/old_module.rs`.
   
## Usage

The runtime page intentionally contains enough prose and links to make candidate
tools parse frontmatter, inline code, relative links, and Markdown headings in
one pass.

### Skipped Level

The skipped level keeps the markdownlint-style heading increment rule active.

## Usage

Duplicate headings should remain visible to candidate engines and Assura.
